symptom: `Tooltip:` on an actionbutton/linkbutton passes check and exec but is never stored; describe omits it; `alter page … set (Tooltip: …) on btn` refused with `property "Tooltip" is not a property of this built-in widget`
cause: Every hop but one carried it: grammar parsed TOOLTIP, staticWidgetKnownProps listed it (so MDL-WIDGET07 stayed quiet), pages.ActionButton had the field and widget_write.go wrote it — but buildButtonV3 never read w.Properties["Tooltip"], so the codec always wrote an empty Texts$Text. describe had no reader for it, and setRawWidgetPropertyMut had no `tooltip` case so it fell to the pluggable setter's refusal
insight: Being on the known-props allow-list proves only that SOME builder consumes the key, not that THIS widget's builder does — the list is a cross-widget union by design. For a silent drop, grep the struct field's writers (`\.Tooltip =`): the codec wrote it and nothing assigned it. Tooltip is a Texts$Text (not a ClientTemplate like Caption), so the ALTER path reuses setTranslatableText on the stored empty Texts$Text; mx check on 11.12.5 accepts a translated tooltip with 0 errors
